name: node-leadfinder
description: LeadFinder — a Node on GROUNDED. Overnight lead watching for businesses that sell to contractors: pull from your sources, read each one, rank by likelihood to convert, and drop anyone you already sell to.
comment_optionalDependencies: Lazy-imported by lib/document-processor.js only when a PDF / .docx / spreadsheet is uploaded — optional so a flaky build can't break a local install. The document intake accepts all three.
